description: The strangler's route ledger: one row per unique verb + path of the NPC Panel 18.6.6 HTTP surface (AIA-reference api-ledger.json, 162 dispatch arms, 153 unique routes), with the AIA status of each. Hand-maintained; packages/aia_core/tests/test_legacy_route_ledger.py keeps it covering exactly the reference's ledger and apps/api/tests/test_legacy_route_claims.py proves every PORTING/PORTED row names a live AIA route. `addenda` lists dispatch arms the reference's parser missed (`path in {…}` sets, OI-48), each anchored to its ui_server.py line and kept apart from the pinned rows until the reference is fixed upstream. Rules: docs/migration/legacy-route-ledger.md.

statuses.LEGACY: served by the oracle only; no AIA route exists
statuses.PORTING: an AIA route serves the capability, and parity against the oracle is not yet PASS
statuses.PORTED: parity PASS from executed gates; the legacy path for this route is retired
statuses.RETIRED: no production equivalent, by the recorded decision named in `decision`

scopes.organization: issued by ScopeResolver for the caller's organization
scopes.study: issued by ScopeResolver for one study; the study id is in the path
scopes.undecided (D8): decided when the route is ported, never inferred from the reference (R14)
